beats.care: Daily Tambaram commuter? Platform changes should get easier soon, though the new foot overbridge's street access is still poor.
beats.what: 7 of 9 new lifts are built; 5 await inspection and 2 need approach paths. Escalators for a new foot overbridge are underway.
beats.why: Tambaram is a busy terminal. Lifts help older people, wheelchair users and anyone with luggage change platforms.

cards.body: Plus 10 lifts in total, says Southern Railway.
cards.caption: escalators when work is done

cards.body: The bigger Amrit Bharat redevelopment of Tambaram station hasn't started yet.

cards.q: At a busy station, you take…

opts: They help people with luggage, wheelchairs or age change platforms
cards.q: Why do lifts at a busy station matter?
cards.why: Lifts make platforms reachable for people who can't easily use stairs.

hook: Climbing stairs at *Tambaram station* may get easier by December

learn.t: Tambaram now handles more originating passengers than Chennai Central among the city's three main terminals.

sources.name: DT Next
sources.title: Tambaram station's lift, escalator works will be completed by December

tldr: Southern Railway says Tambaram station will get 9 more lifts and 10 escalators by December.
watch: Lifts for Platforms 5-6 and 7-8 are targeted for end-November; the rest by December.
